3.name: Vitality of the Tree
3.notes:
Your Rage channels the life force of the World Tree.

• **Vitality Surge** — When you activate your Rage, you gain Temporary Hit Points equal to your Barbarian level.
• **Life-Giving Force** — At the start of each of your turns while raging, choose a creature within 10 feet. That creature gains Temporary Hit Points equal to a roll of d6s equal to your Rage Damage bonus. Any remaining Temporary Hit Points vanish when your Rage ends.

6.name: Branches of the Tree
6.notes: When a creature you can see starts its turn within 30 feet of you while you are raging, you can take a Reaction to summon spectral branches around it. The target must succeed on a Strength save (DC = 8 + your Strength modifier + Proficiency Bonus) or be teleported to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of you (or the nearest unoccupied space you can see). After the teleport, you can reduce the target's Speed to 0 until the end of the current turn.

10.name: Battering Roots
10.notes:
During your turn, your reach with any Heavy or Versatile melee weapon increases by 10 feet.

When you hit with such a weapon on your turn, you can activate the Push or Topple mastery property in addition to another mastery property you are already using with that weapon.

14.name: Travel Along the Tree
14.notes:
When you activate your Rage, and as a Bonus Action while raging, you can teleport up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.

Once per Rage, you can instead teleport up to 150 feet and bring up to six willing creatures within 10 feet of you. Each creature teleports to an unoccupied space of your choice within 10 feet of your destination.
